ambiguities.source_text: Use the SWIFT Bank Code lookup table to bring in additional information
ambiguities.intent: Join the transaction Bank to the lookup Bank.
Use a left join retaining every transaction.
ambiguities.source_text: Join type: left join (retain all transactions).

ambiguities.intent: Each Bank in the lookup must map to at most one row.
ambiguities.source_text: Relationship constraint: each `Bank` value in the lookup must map to at most one row (many transactions to one bank record).
